name: P3_rare_E2_all_cs
about: Milestone 1 model config: CoralScapes + all five labelled locations (+ Raja Ampat), 2x training steps, rare-class crop sampling. Chosen by mean held-out-site validation mIoU over 3 seeds; the shipped checkpoint is seed 2 (best validation).
architecture: fpn_resnet34_dappm (ResNet-34 + FPN-lite 64 ch + DAPPM on C5), 22.47 M params, Kria DPU-legal ops
coralscapes: yes, 4-class labels used as partial 7-class labels (LIVE->ALIVE, BLEACHED->BLEACHED, DEGRADED->{DEAD,ROCK}, OTHER->{ROCK,SAND,OCEAN,OTHER})
optimizer: AdamW, OneCycle, peak lr 0.001, weight decay 1e-4, fp16 autocast
rare_classes: DEAD, SAND, OCEAN, ALIVE (crop centred on one of these with probability 0.5)
selection: best validation mIoU epoch per run; best seed by validation
inference: raw-pixel photo, long side 1024, centre-pad to a multiple of 256 with the ImageNet mean pixel, one whole-frame pass, crop the pad
hardware_used: RTX 4090 (RunPod), ~31 min per seed, 50.5 s/epoch at 95 % GPU utilisation in the profile check
